memo: [English Medium Course]
crs_outline:
Semiconductor technology is at the heart of every advanced electronic system—smartphones, 5G infrastructure, AI accelerators, cloud computing, electric vehicles, and beyond. As these applications surge, the demand for innovative semiconductor devices and materials has never been higher.
This course provides a foundational yet forward-looking introduction to Semiconductor Physics and Devices, the core knowledge required for researchers and engineers in the Semiconductor, IC, optoelectronics, and power electronics industries.
半導體技術是所有先進電子系統的核心——從智慧型手機、5G 基礎建設、AI 加速器、雲端運算到電動車，都不可或缺。隨著這些應用快速成長，對創新半導體元件與材料的需求也達到前所未有的高度。
本課程將從基礎到前瞻，帶來「半導體物理與元件」的完整介紹，這是所有從事半導體、積體電路、光電、電力電子等領域的研究者與工程師必備的核心知識。

We will cover:
1. Fundamental semiconductor material properties
2. Carrier transport: drift, diffusion, and recombination
3. Operating principles of key devices: p–n diode, BJT, MOSFET, and JFET
4. Emerging challenges in device scaling (short-channel effects, ultra-thin dielectrics, SS limits)
5. A forward look into beyond-Moore technologies, including new materials, architectures, and device concepts
By combining rigorous physics with real-world examples and the latest industry trends, the course prepares students for careers in semiconductor R&D, IC design, reliability engineering, and advanced manufacturing.

課程內容涵蓋：
1. 半導體材料的基本特性
2. 載子傳輸機制：漂移、擴散與復合
3. 重要元件的操作原理：p–n 接面二極體、BJT、MOSFET、JFET
4. 元件微縮時所面臨的新挑戰：短通道效應、超薄介電層、次臨界擺幅限制等
5. 超越摩爾定律的前瞻技術，包括新材料、新架構與創新元件概念

本課程透過嚴謹的物理推導、實例分析與產業最新趨勢，協助學生建立扎實的半導體基礎，並為未來在半導體研發、IC 設計、可靠度工程及先進製造領域的職涯發展做好準備。

Intended Learning Outcomes (ILOs)（預期學習成果）
By the end of the course, you will be able to:
1. Explain the essential semiconductor material properties and device physics.
2. Analyze the operating principles of p–n diodes, MOSFETs, BJTs, and JFETs using physical models.
3. Evaluate modern scaling challenges—short-channel effects, ultra-thin dielectrics, subthreshold swing limits—and identify the underlying device-physics problems.
4. Propose innovative device structures or design strategies to address limitations in next-generation semiconductor technologies.
-Innovation begins with understanding and solving the right problems.

預期學期成果:
在本課程結束時，修課的學生能夠：
1.解釋半導體材料特性及元件物理
2.利用元件物理分析半導體原件操作原理。
3.評估在微縮下半導體元件的議題，包含短通道效應、超薄介電層及次臨界擺伏限制。
4.提出元件設計來克服半導體元件發展的挑戰。

cos_cname: 半導體元件可靠度及其失效物理
memo: [English Medium Course](1)開學後加退選階段：開放外系及外校選課；開放填寫google加簽表單且依規定加簽。加簽方式會在第一堂課時說明並提供表單，欲加簽同學第一堂課請務必要來。
cos_ename: Reliability and Failure Physics of Semiconductor Devices
crs_outline:
"Reliability is, after all, engineering in its most practical form" said by James R. Schlesinger - Former US Secretary of State for Defense. Reliability is an essential part of a successful semiconductor product because it is related to trust. No reliability is equal to no business. Especially, the new technologies based on the advanced designs and novel materials, e.g., FinFETs, high k dielectrics, wide bandgap, Ferroelectric, or 2D materials, cannot be commercialized without the proven reliability. Therefore, a good R&D engineer should recognize the statistical tools/characterization methods, identify the reliability issues,and evaluate failure physics, further designing for reliability. In this course, the basic semiconductor devices/processes, statistical tools, and characterization methods for reliability evaluation are covered. Furthermore, four most important main reliability challenges (Bias temperature instability & interface traps / Time dependent dielectric breakdown / Mass transport-induced failures / Electrostatic discharge (ESD)) will be addressed in this class. 

前美國國防部部長 James R. Schlesinger曾說：可靠度是工程中最實際的層面。高可靠度是所有半導體產品成功的重要因素，因為可靠度與客戶對產品的信任有關。沒有可靠度等於沒有客戶的信賴而失去商業價值。對先進的半導體技術，例如FinFET、高介電常數絕緣層、寬能隙、鐵電或二維材料等，如果無法通過可靠度驗證，這些技術將無法商品化。因此，優秀的研發工程師應該具備評估可靠度所需統計工具/量測方法來確定可靠度問題，並評估特性衰退的物理特性，並進一步設計高可靠度產品。本課程中將深入淺出的介紹基本半導體元件/製程及可靠度評估所需的統計工具和量測方法。此外，本課程也將會探討四個最重要也最常見的半導體元件可靠度議題（偏壓溫度不穩定性和界面缺陷 Bias temperature instability & interface traps / 依時性閘極崩潰 Time dependent dielectric breakdown / 質量傳輸引起的故障 Mass transport-induced failures / 靜電放電 ESD）。

Intended Learning Outcomes (ILOs):
By the end of this class, you should be able to:
1. Explain the basic operation principles and fabrication processes for the MOS type semiconductor technologies
2. Apply the basic statistics/statistical tools for reliability analysis 
3. Evaluate the failure physics of reliability issues 
4. Present the reliability issues using your own word
5. Design for reliability (DFR)

預期學習成果：
在本課程結束時，修課的學生能夠：
1.解釋MOS半導體技術的基本工作原理和製程
2.應用基本的統計工具進行可靠度分析
3.評估導致不穩定元件特性的失效物理機制
4.闡述對可靠度問題的見解
5.增強可靠度的元件設計（Design for reliability）

P.S. The course structure was originally designed by Prof. Guido Groeseneken (imec/KU Leuven) for the class “Reliability and Yield in Micro- and Nanoelectronic Components,” which I attended during 09–12/2011. I sincerely appreciate Prof. Groeseneken for his exceptional course and for his guidance that shaped my foundation in the reliability field.

memo: 英文授課、開放隨班附讀[English Medium Course]
crs_outline:
Bio-lab on a chip (Bio-LOC) is a device that integrates several laboratory functions on a single chip; It deals with the handling of extremely small fluid volumes. Bio-LOC is closely related to, and overlaps with, microfluidics, which describes primarily the physics, the manipulation and study of minute amounts of fluids. The devices are a subset of MEMS devices and often indicated by "Micro Total Analysis Systems" (μTAS) as well. Several specific topics will be taught in this course that includes: 1. Microfluidic devices, 2. DNA microarrays, 3. Protein microarrays, 4. Nano-biosensor, 5. Single DAN sequence, and et al. The field of this course covers basic chemistry, biochemistry, nano-technology, semi-conductance-technology, and applications of these multidisciplinary sciences. 

醫療科技的發展，個人化醫學的需求逐漸浮現。微小化、智慧化、高通量化與遠距化成為是技術的生醫發展的共同趨勢。本課程主旨在使同學對生物晶片有基本之認識，內容將涵蓋microfluidic devices, DNA microarrays，protein microarrays之操作原理，製作過程，以及應用範圍。課程中將生物晶片之種類與適用問題進行科學性、通俗性與系統性介紹，讓學生能夠有系統學習、易懂、並能實用。同時希望學生能藉由瞭解生物晶片及各式生醫系統之原理，引領學生對生物醫學檢測等基礎知識有所認知。並能啟發學生將來能協助生醫微製造技術(BioMEMS)的發展。因此課程設計上包括：1. 課程講授。2.學期末報告。另外上課以英文簡報介紹，培養學生未來以英文吸收專業知識之能力。

cos_cname: 研究對象權益之保障與法律議題
memo: 醫電所(原生醫所)主開(通識課程)
cos_ename: Protection of Research Subjects Rights and Legal Issues
costype: 領域課程-公民與倫理思考
crs_outline:
一、課程目標
（一）瞭解以「人」為研究對象之倫理與法規。
（二）探討研究對象權益保護之實務案例。
（三）學習研究計畫審查內容及參與者同意書之撰寫。
The goal is to: (a) understand the research ethics and regulations of  human subject research,(b) explore the case of protection of research subjects rights, and(c) learn to write research protocols and consents of research subjects.
二、課程概述
保護以「人」為研究對象之權益，已成為研究者應遵守的普世價值。我國於2011年12月28日公布施行之《人體研究法》，即是落實人體研究有關研究對象之保護，並且要求研究者進行研究前，應擬定研究計畫，經倫理審查委員會審查通過，始可為之。再者，以「人」為研究對象之相關法規，尚有《醫療法》、《人體試驗管理辦法》、《藥品優良臨床試驗作業準則》、《醫療器材管理法》、《醫療器材優良臨床試驗管理辦法》、《人體生物資料庫管理條例》、《個人資料保護法》等，故研究者進行研究時，亦應注意上述法規有關研究對象保護之特別規定，以免觸犯法令規定。是以，本課程首先是要讓學生了解研究倫理概念與相關規範，包括研究倫理之源起、原則與法令，以重視研究倫理之重要性。其次，透過實務案例之討論與分析，讓學生認識有關研究對象權益保護之法規內容，避免違反法令規定。最後，協助學生撰寫研究計畫書與參與者同意書，以申請倫理審查委員會之審查。
本課程設計包括：（一）以「人」為研究對象之研究倫理與相關法規的講授。（二）個人書面報告及討論。（三）撰寫研究計畫書與參與者同意書。希冀同學進行有關「人」的研究行為符合研究倫理與相關法規之規定，並且有撰寫研究計畫書與參與者同意書之能力，以獲得倫理審查委員會之審查通過，讓研究行為具有正當性及合法性。
The protection of research subjects rights has become a universal value that researchers should observe. The “ Human Subjects Research Act"  took effect on December 28, 2011. This Act is specially stipulated to regulate the right protection of human research subjects. Prior to conduct a research, the principal investigator shall submit the research protocol for review and approval by the Institutional Review Board (hereinafter “IRB"). Furthermore, the relevant laws and regulations on protection of research subjects rights include the “ Medical Care Act", “ Regulations on Human Trials ", “ Regulations for Good Clinical Practice", “ Medical Devices Act",“ Regulations on Good Clinical Practice for Medical Devices" ,“ Human Biobank Management Act", and “ Personal Data Protection Act". Therefore, before conducting research, you should also pay attention to the special provisions of the above-mentioned laws and regulations on protection of research subjects to avoid violating laws and regulations. This course is to enable students to understand the concept and related norms of research ethics, including the origin, principles and regulations. Secondly, through the discussion and analysis of cases, students can understand the contents of regulations related to protection of research subjects rights. Finally, students can learn to write research protocols and consents of research subjects to apply for review by IRB.

memo: 醫電所(原生醫所).生科.MD-PhD學程.應化、開放隨班附讀
crs_outline:
化學是理解生命現象、疾病機制、藥物作用及生物醫學工程技術的重要基礎。然而，許多工程與資訊背景的學生往往對化學感到陌生甚至畏懼，使得在學習生醫相關知識時遭遇不小的門檻。

事實上，化學與我們的日常生活及健康照護息息相關。例如：COVID-19期間常見的酒精乾洗手成分為何？次氯酸水與漂白水有何差異？是否可以直接接觸皮膚？疫苗是如何研發出來的？症狀治療藥物與抗病毒藥物有何不同？藥用洗髮精與一般洗髮精的成分差異在哪裡？食品添加物、塑化劑、三聚氰胺、銅葉綠素等議題又隱含哪些化學原理？此外，藥品仿單上那些看似艱深的英文化學名稱，究竟代表什麼意義？

本課程將以生物醫學工程的觀點出發，結合生活案例、醫療應用及時事議題，介紹化學在人體、生物材料、藥物、醫療器材及健康照護中的角色。課程內容兼顧基礎理論與實務應用，透過深入淺出的方式，協助學生建立生醫化學的核心概念，培養判讀醫療與健康資訊的能力，並為未來進階生醫工程、智慧醫療、生物科技及臨床應用相關課程奠定基礎。

修習本課程後，學生將能：
1. 建立生醫化學之基本知識與核心概念。
2. 了解化學原理在人體、生理、疾病及醫療中的應用。
3. 具備閱讀與理解常見藥物、保健食品及醫療產品成分資訊的能力。
4. 能以科學觀點分析生活中的健康與醫療相關議題。
5. 建立跨領域思維，銜接生物醫學工程、智慧醫療及生技產業之進階學習需求。

如果您覺得化學很可怕，那麼這門課正是為您而設計；如果您覺得化學很有趣，那麼這門課將帶您看見化學如何改變醫療、科技與人類健康。

crs_outline:
This course focuses on the fundamentals of medical image processing and its applications in machine learning. Students will systematically learn essential techniques such as image sampling and quantization, image enhancement, edge detection and sharpening, spatial domain filtering, morphological operations, image analysis, and segmentation. Special emphasis will be placed on feature extraction—a critical step for tasks like image segmentation and classification using machine learning. Through hands-on Python programming, students will bridge theory and practice to solve real-world problems in medical imaging. This course also serves as a foundational step toward deep learning in the following semester.
*Course Objectives
1. Master fundamental image processing techniques: Understand and implement basic algorithms for sampling, quantization, enhancement, and filtering.
2. Develop strong feature extraction skills: Learn to extract discriminative statistical, morphological, and texture features from images for machine learning models.
3. Apply machine learning to medical images: Use classification and segmentation models to address real-world challenges in medical imaging and evaluate model performance.
4. Strengthen Python programming skills: Build complete image processing and machine learning pipelines using Python and key libraries (e.g., NumPy, OpenCV, scikit-image, scikit-learn).
5. Foster problem-solving mindset: Gain the ability to analyze new imaging problems, select appropriate techniques, and rapidly prototype solutions, laying a solid foundation for future work in deep learning.

memo: [English Medium Course]
crs_outline: Silicon photonics is an innovative field that merges photonics and electronics to manipulate light on a photonic chip. By leveraging silicon's optical properties, this technology enables the integration of optical components like waveguides, modulators, and detectors directly onto silicon chips. This integration facilitates faster data transmission and processing speeds, lower power consumption, and compact device designs.  This course aims to provide students with a fundamental understanding of silicon photonics, covering key topics such as applications, device properties, and fabrication processes. Students will also gain practical experience by realizing the optical functionalities of waveguides through numerical simulations.

crs_outline:
本課程旨在探討現代光學檢測系統的核心物理原理與其前沿技術實務。課程內容將從基礎的光電
主動元件(光源、調變器、偵測器)出發,進而深入探討當前光電產業與學術界之最新檢測技術專題。

技術實務:利用 AI 輔助工具,分析論文,了解並學習其數據分析與呈現的邏輯。
成果發表:學習建構專業技術報告,並進行學術成果之發表與答辯。

Overview of conferences

Brief verbal explanation
Poster presentation session
Design of powerpoint slides
Opening, body and ending
Problem, question, and delivery style and visual aids
How to chair a session

crs_outline: Welcome to PTIB30004 (formerly IIB5116), the elective one-semester, 3-credit-hour course, Introduction to Liquid Crystals, for photonics graduate students. The field of liquid crystals is multidisciplinary, requiring concepts and techniques from chemistry and physics at the very least and in some cases also demanding ideas from materials science, mathematics, biology and some types of engineering. While a good foundation in physics and basic knowledge of organic chemistry are prerequisites, this course covers the most important aspects of the physics, chemistry and materials science of liquid crystals for graduate students with no or little knowledge of the field. It should provide an introduction to the science of liquid crystals that allows more advanced books to be read with good understanding.

cos_ename: Civil Law: General Provisions of Obligations
crs_outline:
課程概述與目標：
民法乃法律人必備的基本功，若地基打得好，無論目標是往上加蓋多少樓層，或興建任何式樣新穎的房子，都可輕鬆達成，事半功倍。因此，凡法律人，不分專精領域為何，民法均乃必修課目。債總是學習民法者必須打通的任督二脈，無論是法定之債或是意定之債，熟知法條操作的基礎以及準用或類推適用法條的原理原則，均有助於法律邏輯的推論以及強化認事用法的能力。本課程目的除了教授學生如何從市場經濟主導下的契約自由原則出發，熟稔各種債的基本原理原則之外，亦希望隨著課堂上對法律概念的介紹、實例題的演練，引導同學反覆推敲如何將一個複雜的法律事實濃縮爭點，將之由繁化簡，並透過三段論法以及請求權基礎解答法，將所有可能存在的債法問題逐一破解。
主要課程內容：
1. 契約法之重要概念。
2. 侵權行為法之重要概念。
3. 其他法定債之關係的重要概念。
學習目標：
1. 理解債法之基本內涵。
2. 運用債法之各項規定。
3. 分析重要的實務議題。
預期學習成果：
1.	掌握債法之基本內涵並能適用於具體事實之中，針對債法議題作出詳盡之法律分析。
2.	具備閱讀法院判決與分析其法律意見之利益。

crs_outline:
本課程著重於跨領域學習並分兩個主軸: 

* Track A 協助法律人掌握資訊科技的重要基礎概念

* Track B 透過資訊科技應在法律領域培養實作能力

Track A 將以 CS50 for Lawyers (哈佛大學針對法律系學生設計之 Computer Science 入門課程) 為主，解說重要基礎概念如: Computational Thinking, Programming Languages, Algorithms, Data Structures, Cryptography, Cybersecurity, Internet Technologies, Cloud Computing, Web Development, Database Design, Cybersecurity, etc. 課堂上將透過同學們事先提問的問題，協助非技術背景同學建立對資訊科技的直觀理解，以便日後面對科技相關法律案件時，具備相當程度的掌握能力。

Track B 將透過 CS50P (Programming with Python) 建立初步程式設計概念，並補充說明人工智慧領域的應用，協助同學在資訊科技最基礎與最新發展兩端，都能有所認識並思考應用於法律領域的各種可能。

預期同學之學習成果：
1. 能掌握資訊科技之基礎知識與人工智慧之發展動態。
2. 能就技術本質深入思考與資訊科技相關的法律議題。
3. 能認識 LegalTech 應用潛力並培養實作能力。
4. 期末專題針對 Track A 或 Track B 擇一研究。

memo: [English Medium Course]限科法所同學選修
crs_outline:
The course is designed to train lawyering skills through moot court training based on and/or participation in Annual Willem C. Vis (East) international Commercial Arbitration Moot competition. Traditional legal education does not provide adequate training on lawyering skills, such as research, legal argumentation, legal persuasive writing, as well as efficient and effective oral communications with the adjudicating tribunals. This course intends to fill the gap. Through the course students will understand the functions and practices of international commercial arbitral tribunals. In addition, students will be required to conduct research, to write written submissions, and to present oral arguments through teamwork. Students will, accordingly, acquire essential skills necessary for the career of international lawyer.
Accordingly, the core of the course is to train advocacy ability of the students. The emphasis is thus not on legal rules. Instead, the focus of the teaching will be on the writing and oral abilities. The actual content of the course will be adjusted according to the Vis Moot problem of the year. There will be no lectures in the class. Instead, the course will focus on exercises of legal research, legal writing, and oral presentation skills. Students are expected to conduct their own necessary research and study. Students will be divided into groups. Tasks including research, writing, and oral practices will be assigned both to individual students and groups.

crs_outline:
Course Description:
This international negotiation simulation centers around a virtual exchange with students at the IU McKinney School of Law in Indianapolis, United States. Students will be divided into two teams: one team composed of IU McKinney students representing a US technology company (IndyTech Corporation or “IndyTech”) and the other team composed of NYCU students representing a Taiwanese semiconductor company (Hsinchu Semiconductor Corporation or “HSC”). The two companies are interested in working together to exploit a newly discovered element, Changesium (pronounced “Chang-ee-zee-um”) that may increase the speed of semiconductor chips. The form of their collaboration could be a joint venture, a licensing agreement, a long-term supply contract, or a combination of one or more of these agreements. The negotiations will take place through written exchanges and through real-time virtual negotiations. 

The thrust of the virtual component of the course is to simulate the growing virtual nature of the negotiations process. Students are expected to spend time outside of class, working with their team, to prepare for class discussions involving email exchanges as well as to prepare for the virtual negotiations. Class discussions will focus on the strategy for, and progress of, the virtual negotiations, as well as the substantive legal, business, and policy matters that impact on the negotiations. This simulation exposes participants to the complexity of virtual negotiating between businesses across borders.

Course Objectives:
Upon completion of this course, an engaged student will be able to:
•	Conduct an interest-based negotiation.
•	Plan an effective strategy for negotiation that includes
o	Assessing the client’s position, by identifying the client’s interests, BATNA, Reservation Point, and Target Point.
o	Assessing the other party’s position, by estimating the party’s interests, BATNA, Reservation Point, and Target Point.
o	Estimating a Zone of Possible Agreement (ZOPA).
o	Assessing additional factors surrounding the negotiation (including cultural context, political situations, economic situation, industry, labor issues, and capital infrastructure).
o	Identifying the negotiation issues (conflicting interests between the parties). 
o	Bundling issues in multi-issue negotiations.
o	Preparing an opening offer or responding to an offer.
•	Draft and properly time written communications, professional and appropriate in tone, to the other party.
•	Assess one’s own negotiation style and employ methods to strengthen weaknesses. Recognize and aptly respond to the other party’s negotiation style.
•	Determine and communicate a reasonable opening offer that maximizes value to your client. Adeptly respond to an opening offer.
•	Skillfully gather information from the other party and strategically reveal your client’s information to the other party.
•	Identify ethical issues and respond appropriately.
•	Employ appropriate blocking techniques to avoid answering certain questions.
•	Respond appropriately to surprise information.
•	Make properly timed principled concessions.
•	Distribute value between the parties.
•	Effectively employ strategies to move beyond counter-productive emotions and impasse.
•	Recognize when to walk away from a deal.
•	Conduct a post-negotiation evaluation.

一、培養校級基本素養與核心能力：
＊資訊素養 
＊品德教育 
＊國際視野 
＊發現及解決問題的能力 
＊跨界多元思考的能力 
＊群己平衡的認知 
二、培養管理學院學生基本素養與核心能力：
＊發掘、分析管理相關領域問題、尋求解決答案並進行決策的能力 
三、培養科法碩學生基本素養與核心能力：
＊建立從事法律實務工作應具備的法學專業素養、國際觀與倫理思維 
＊培養對社會時事發展的觀察與分析能力 
＊發現及解決問題的能力 
＊科際間知識的整合以及實證研究方法　
預期學習成果:
若上述學習目標能力皆能具備當然最好，但在完成本課程後，學生最應該具備發表學術研究之能力、在學術會議發表之能力以及對學術作品進行思考與批判之能力。

costype: 領域課程-公民與倫理思考
crs_outline:
課程概述與目標：
我國民法繼受德國民法典，而有民法總則的設置。民法總則編沿襲19世紀學說匯纂（Pandektenwissenschaft）學者的理念，認為權利主體、權利客體及法律行為是私法的基本構成元素，故應在所有民法篇章之前加以規定。這個理念，使民法總則的規範內容過於抽象、脫離生活現實。故本課程設計上將以具體之契約類型（如買賣）為基礎，結合具體案例，使學生較容易掌握民法總則中各項法律概念的內容。為此，本課程內容之範圍將不限於民法總則的條文，依課程需要，亦將跨及債編總論、債編各論、物權甚至身份法之領域，俾使學生能在學習民法的初步階段能對民事法有。本課程雖名之為民法總則，然實際內容上則較接近於民事財產法導論，此亦符合目前德國大學法學院之主流趨勢。此外，為使大一新生能儘速適應法律系考試的答題方式，本課程特別安排實例演習時間，使學生在面對多變之案例事實時，也能熟練運用法條。儘管如此，本課程仍保留合理限度之學術性質，為學生在往後的法律學習打造堅實的基礎。
主要課程內容：
法律適用的基本概念、民事法的規範體系、權利主體論、法律行為論、權利客體論、代理制度、消滅時效、條件、期限與消滅時效
學習目標：
1. 建立對私法關係的基礎認識
2. 法律解釋、抽象法律概念及民法學說理論之掌握。
3. 借重請求權基礎思維，學習將法律適用於具體個案之方法。
預期學習成果：
初步學習到民法規範私人間關係之基礎規範架構，認識個別規範間之關連，瞭解解釋法律之不同方式（法學方法論），以請求權基礎之思考方式，分析具體個案事實，以奠定未來學習債法及物權法之基礎。
上課方式：口授為主（實體教室、網路同步、網路非同步）

costype: 領域課程-公民與倫理思考
crs_outline:
法律是人類社會中重要的一環，影響生活中的各個面向。法律除了包含抽象的條文與理論，也涉及具體的社會實況。世界各國由於文化、政治、經濟等差異，形成並擁有不同的法律內涵；這些獨特的歷史經驗，影響了當代社會中的法律議題與因應之道。我們身處在台灣，應了解台灣在特有的環境與條件下，法律在過去發展及轉變的過程，連結現今法律的歷史脈絡。

本課程以台灣為主體，介紹這塊地域從以前到現在的法律秩序與內涵，包括原住民法等複數法律文明時期（史前至1683年）、以漢人法律傳統為主的清朝統治時期（1683–1895）、開始引進近代西方法的日本統治時期（1895–1945）、到中華民國時期與當代社會（1945迄今），讓學生了解曲折複雜而多元豐富的台灣法律史。

本課程將依照時序，分別探討重要的法律主題，包括憲法（政府組織與人權發展）、行政法（地方制度與選舉）、司法審判、法律專業社群（法官、檢察官、律師）、刑事法律與政策、民事法與土地關係、原住民法與權利等制度，以及這些法規在社會生活中的實際運作情形。

課程目標在於讓歷史思維進入法學研究與論證，了解外來法制與在地經驗的互動與變化過程。藉由寬廣且深遠的法律史觀，提升批判性思考的能力，建立包容與尊重差異的觀點。

crs_outline:
本課程為必修，經由指導教授對碩士班研究生一對一的個別指導，以提升修課同學撰寫論文之能力，並充實修課同學之論文內容，而使修課學生在論文研究上獲得較具體的成效。
主要課程內容：主要包含三大部分
第一為對自己研究的結果進行報告，以發展論文研究主題。第二部分是對於同學之報告提出回應與批評，以熟悉該領域之專業知識，並發展對議題之思考與評論之技巧。第三部分則是針對自己的研究結果撰寫書面報告，以提升文字運用之技巧與理論架構之能力，作為論文發展之一部分。
學習目標：培養學生以下幾種能力
一、	針對特定議題進行研究之能力。
二、	於會議上發表論文之能力。
三、	針對特定議題進行批判、思考與對話之能力。
四、	撰寫學術文章之能力。
預期學習成果：
修習完成本課程後，學生應該具備針對特定議題進行研究之能力、於會議上發表論文之能力、針對特定議題進行批判、思考與對話之能力以及撰寫學術文章之能力。

cos_ename: Electron transport in low-dimensional systems and memories concepts
dep_cname: 國際半導體產業學院博士班
crs_outline:
The course covers materials science and solid-state physics for macro- to nanoscale electronic devices, with a primary focus on their resistive and conductive properties. Particular attention is devoted to the fundamental physical mechanisms underlying various memory technologies, analyzed from the perspective of barrier profiles and switching phenomena in FeRAM, ReRAM, and MRAM devices.
The operating principles of spin-based magnetic electronic devices are also discussed, including magnetic domain walls in nanowires, skyrmion-related resistance effects, magnetic vortices, spin-transfer torque phenomena, and related concepts.
Seminars and homework assignments include elements of device modeling and numerical simulation using high-level computational tools such as Wolfram Mathematica and MATLAB.

cos_ename: Special Topics on Legal Research Methodology
crs_outline:
一直以來我國法律學研究受到法律繼受文化與註釋法學的桎梏，往往造成法學解釋與實務應用上的落差。法律研究方法之中，法學實證研究屬於其中重要內容。法學實證研究將透過資訊的分析、比對，正可用於檢驗法律適用之可行性或不足之處。擬以法學實證研究作為論文研究方法、或對此研究方法有興趣之同學， 歡迎選修此門課程。

傳統法學研究，著重外國法制的比較介紹，以及法律自主體系的邏輯，無法真正反應法律現象。而法律之實際運作狀況，法律對於社會產生之影響，以及法律與其他社會科學的互動關係，都有待實際資料的蒐集與驗證，而非先驗學說理論可以解答。本課程之目標，係以介紹重要法學研究方法，其中以法學實證研究（empirical legal study）為其中重點，包括其意涵及其研究方法為主，透過實際案例、學者論述的分析研讀以及實際操作，引導同學思考法學實證研究的時代意義。

主要課程內容：
1.	學習實證分析之基本概念
2.	了解基礎統計概念
3.	瞭解相關之統計軟體與資料庫

學習目標：
期許學生能透過掌握法學實證研究方法，並以此作為論文研究工具之一。

預期學習成果：
1.	對於實證方法有相當的瞭解，並能指出傳統法學理論之問題
2.	對統計與實證方法有相當之瞭解，並瞭解其優點與限制具備進行實證研究與使用統計軟體之基礎能力

cos_ename: Introduction to Programming for Semiconductor Devices

crs_outline:
The course provides the basement for improving programming skills in MATLAB (a little bit for Wolfram Mathematica) combining them with problems from physics and electronics, pre-open the methods of the novel electronic device simulation related to concepts, where not only the charge of electrons is used, but also its spin degree of freedom.  The course begins with simple problems from classical physics.
The course allows to upgrade the programming skills in the basement of problems from solid state and quantum physics to semiconductor device simulation.
Moreover, programming is related to PROBLEM-SOLVING ＆amp; DECISION-MAKING possibilities:
1. An Endurance in problem-solving: Code issues will never (ever!) fix themselves and simply need to be tracked down and dealt with.  Anticipating mistakes: Whether you are a beginner or an expert programmer, you are fully aware and prepared for making mistakes. In a job as precise as this, it is simply unavoidable. You quickly learn to anticipate yours and others’future mistakes. This more often than not extends to being ready for the unexpected. Great attitude to have, when you think about it.
Weighing facts: When faced with a difficult choice to make, programmers tend to use a graphic aid of a simple table with pros and cons. Often, doing this helps to eliminate the emotional factors and speed the process up.
THINKING Logic: Because of the way computers and code operate (strict causality), there is no way to remove logic from most of a programmer's day's work.

crs_outline:
Course Description

This course introduces the fundamental semiconductor physics underlying modern energy-conversion technologies. Students will learn how quantum mechanics, electronic band structures, density of states (DOS), carrier statistics, and charge transport govern the behavior of semiconductor materials. The course emphasizes the analysis of metal–semiconductor contacts, p–n junctions, heterojunctions, and semiconductor–electrolyte interfaces, and their roles in determining charge separation and transfer in solar cells, photoelectrochemical water-splitting systems, and related energy applications.

Objectives

By the end of this course, students will be able to:

• Explain the fundamental concepts of quantum mechanics, electronic band structures, and density of states in semiconductor materials.

• Analyze carrier distributions, Fermi levels, and charge transport processes in intrinsic and doped semiconductors.

• Interpret and construct energy-band diagrams for metals, semiconductors, metal–semiconductor contacts, p–n junctions, and heterojunctions.

• Evaluate charge separation, carrier transport, and recombination mechanisms using band alignment and density-of-states analysis.

• Analyze the effects of junction design and interfacial electronic structure on device performance.

• Apply thermodynamic and kinetic principles to charge-transfer processes in semiconductor-based energy systems.

• Assess semiconductor materials and interfaces for applications in photovoltaic devices, photoelectrochemical water splitting, photocatalysis, and related renewable-energy technologies.

crs_outline: Compact models serve as a bridge or a translator between the physics-based half of the semiconductor industry (devices and foundries) and its computer-based half (EDA tools and IC design). This course will comprehensively cover the physics and modeling aspects of semiconductor devices, including MOS capacitors and MOSFETs, along with their non-ideal effects. The course aims to delve into the strategies for developing models that meet the industry's requirements for accuracy, computational speed, and robustness. Students will be introduced to industry-standard models such as BSIM-BULK and BSIM-CMG and will also learn benchmarking tests for compact models. Additionally, the course will familiarize students with EDA tools, including SPICE, Verilog-A hardware description language, and ICCAP parameter extraction software, preparing them for real-world applications.

costype: 領域課程-公民與倫理思考
crs_outline:
人工智慧的突破性發展，不僅對人類社會產生前所未有的衝擊，也對既有法律概念及制度造成史無前例的挑戰。在技術快速發展下，法律面應該如何加以規範? 藉由人工智慧而生的產出物，究應由誰擁有智慧財產權？無人車肇事誰應負責？人工智慧對法律服務業會造成何種衝擊？機器人會犯罪嗎？本課程檢視國內外既有文獻及案例，為學習者提供清楚的議題藍圖及深度分析。本課程在授課內容上分三大部分: (1) 人工智慧相關之法律規範，(2) 人工智慧技術在法律領域之運用，(3) 針對重要主題由不同老師深入剖析。

在課程目標方面，藉由課程及討論，同學應能掌握技術面及法制面的基本概念，並進一步探討案例及適用法規。在現今社會整體科技快速發展下，法律背景的同學除須具備法律素養外，更應具備接納新知、研讀、吸收的能力，理工醫背景的同學亦可藉由此課程熟悉法律制度，在發展技術的同時，兼顧法律及倫理議題，並藉由案例判讀、期末報告撰寫的過程，培養對跨領域議題批判思考的能力。

cos_ename: Special Topics and Labs on Artificial Intelligence
dep_cname: 智慧計算與科技研究所
crs_outline:
Unit 1_ Math and Deep Learning(魏澤人)：Introducing math related topics to deep learning and AI. Including math foundation and tools for AI, AI tools for math.
Unit 2_ROS程式設計基礎(陳建志)：
機器人作業系統(Robot Operating System, ROS)是專為開發機器人所設計的開源軟體架構，如今ROS已風行全世界並支援各大廠牌的機器人(Universal Robots, ABB Manipulators, Faunc等)。ROS提供了硬體抽象、設備驅動、函式庫、可視化工具、軟體間訊息傳遞和軟體包管理等功能。ROS背後廣大的社群累積了龐大的能量，除了提供基本工具外，也包含各式各樣的演算法，使得開發者可猶如組裝積木般，一塊塊的將自己想要的機器人快速拼接起來，並專注於開發自己的應用。本課程將引導學生學會相關的ROS基礎與知識，並學會以ROS開發相關應用程式及引用open source資源。

Unit 3_AI software and tools(魏澤人)：Introducing modern AI tools, including API, local LLM, agent, local diffusion models.
Unit 4_智慧農業(林勻蔚)：介紹目前農業相關議題與使用物聯網技術之解決辦法
Unit 5_GPU程式設計-使用OpenGL Shaders (彭其瀚)：
學習使用OpenGL GLSL Shaders來實現3D real-time rendering程式. 本堂課會類似workshop的方式, 與同學一同上機實作電腦圖學中幾個重要的shader programming應用. 使用C++並運用OpenFrameworks 程式開發架構來加速3D程式的開發.

crs_outline:
The goal of this course is to equip students with knowledge and skills in Computer Graphics for a productive role in visual computing, including games and movies, computer aided design, scientific simulation, and computer vision/artificial intelligence. 

After an overview of the computer graphics pipeline, the first portion of the course will teach students how to implement visually stunning yet simple real-time rendering programs via modern shader programming (using C++, OpenGL, and GLSL shaders). The second portion focuses on geometric processing, i.e., the geometric presentations of 3D objects and how to process them for the better. The course will then covers several important topics such as procedural modeling, animations and ray-tracing.

The course will have a two exams (mid-term and final), several programming assignments, and several homeworks.

crs_outline:
The Ultimate Question: What inherently makes some problems computationally effortless while others remain frustratingly difficult?

Despite five decades of intense research, computer scientists still don't have a definitive answer to this question. However, this pursuit has yielded a massive breakthrough: an elegant classification framework that categorizes problems based on their intrinsic difficulty.

This theoretical blueprint has directly revolutionized the ancient field of cryptography. By intentionally building security systems around these certified "hard" problems, cryptographers have successfully engineered entirely new, ultra-secure codes.

crs_outline:
This course is co-designed by Prof. Chih-Chung Hsu and the industry team Kanai Intelligence (Eric Cheng) as an industry-driven, hands-on multimodal AI course. Unlike traditional courses that stop at theory or stay within a single model, it takes students from the fundamentals of computer vision and deep learning all the way to Multimodal Large Language Models (Multimodal LLMs) that understand images, text, and other signals at once, culminating in building a deployable, monitorable, and safeguarded Multi-Modal Agentic System. The content maps end-to-end onto the skills the industry actually needs to build real multimodal AI products.

The course emphasizes learning by doing: every week is paired with hands-on Google Colab practice, and students are encouraged throughout to co-develop code with generative AI tools (Codex, Claude Code, ChatGPT, Gemini, etc.), cultivating real-world AI-assisted engineering skills. Topics span image analysis, deep learning and CNNs, NLP and Transformers, multi-head and multimodal models, Flask front-/back-end web development, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Function Calling and Agent Skills, dynamic code generation, system attack and defense, and cloud deployment with usage/cost monitoring.

Learning objectives:
1. Understand the core principles and technical evolution from computer vision and deep learning to multimodal LLMs.
2. Train, integrate, and evaluate multimodal deep learning models that process images and text simultaneously.
3. Integrate AI models into front-/back-end websites to build interactive multimodal application services.
4. Design multimodal agentic systems with RAG, Function Calling, and Agent Skills.
5. Assess system security, design Moderation and Guardrail mechanisms, and complete cloud deployment with cost/performance monitoring.
6. Become proficient at co-developing with generative AI tools, building engineering skills aligned with the pace of industry.

memo: 資訊學院優先(不開放在職專班網路選課)。1.資安所必選修課程。2.上課教室: CS-PC2。[另外1小時(第3節)以彈性非同步上課方式]
crs_outline:
Software testing is to exercise the program using input data in three different space domains: (1) in the requirement and specification domain, (2) in the program implementation domain, (3) in the test input space domain.  The space covered in (1), (2), (3) will intersect one another and exhibit different properties to reveal the software defects, quality of use, and potential exploitation. Our course will cover several conventional software testing issues: 1. Functional testing, 2. Structural testing, 3. Integration and system testing. Other than these, test plans used in Microsoft and google will be discussed. Nonconventional testing like fuzzing , exploitable testing and symbolic execution will be introduced too.
軟體測試是以輸入資料來操作程式，針對三種不同的範圍來討論: (1) 規格需求的範圍,(2) 程式實作的範圍, (3) 輸入資料的空間範圍。這三種空間的範圍，彼此交集，也呈現不同的特性，展現程式本身的缺陷、品質與可能隱含的資安操作空間。我們的課程將涵蓋傳統測試議題:1. 功能性測試, 2. 結構化測試, 3. 整合與系統測試。同時，我們也介紹微軟與 Google 相關軟體的測試過程，並涵蓋非典型的如 fuzzing、脅迫測試與符號執行測試。

memo: [English Medium Course]115學年度甲乙丙組專業選修
crs_outline:
The primary goal of this course is to provide students with a solid understanding of the fundamental concepts of Generative Artificial Intelligence, develop their practical implementation skills, and enable them to apply these techniques flexibly across different domains. The course also guides students to explore the application of Generative AI in image synthesis, cultivating their ability to implement and experiment with Generative AI methods. Through this course, students will gain deeper insight into the current limitations and challenges of Generative AI and examine future developments in image generation.
This course also invites Dr. Chia-Min Cheng, a senior manager from the AI technology division at MediaTek, to co-teach the class. He will share the latest industry insights and discuss real-world challenges and business opportunities related to Generative AI in Computer Vision and Machine Learning, particularly in the transition from research to commercial products.
Upon completion of the course, students will develop the following core competencies:
․	Fundamental knowledge and technical skills in Generative AI and image generation.
․	Awareness of emerging technologies and the ability to analyze new trends.
․	The ability to conduct independent research and development, along with teamwork and project management skills.
․	Innovative thinking and problem-solving abilities, enabling students to apply their knowledge to promote technological innovation and societal progress.

crs_outline:
機器學習為深度學習的基礎課程，探討如何能由觀測到的資料中自我學習，自我進化，而能自動增進其處理效能。例如進行預測，特徵擷取，分類，模式辨認，決策，各種訊號處理，甚至建立人工智慧等等。

本課程結合業師陳志成博士（意騰科技董事、聯發科技 executive office 顧問、宸耀科技獨立董事）一起授課，將介紹機器學習的基礎演算法、理論及工具。並讓學生嘗試在各種領域中實際實踐這些技術。課程內容包括：(a) 監督式學習（例如參數和非參數演算法、支持向量機和類神經網路等），(b) 無監督學習（例如群聚、降維和自監督學習等），(c)強化式學習（例如馬可夫決策過程，Ｑ學習與貪婪演算法），(d) 機器學習應用實例（例如語音信號處理，影像訊號處理，音訊訊號處理與自然語言處理，資訊擷取與資料搜尋等）。

此外，本課程的業師將從業界的角度分享最新的趨勢、技術與應用，並進行機器學習實戰競賽（例如Kaggle InClass Competition）。

crs_outline:
This course is designed to provide an in-depth introduction to Information Security Practice and Regulation. Its primary objective is to impart a comprehensive understanding of international standards of information security and the best practice for industry. Topics range from security or privacy-oriented standards such as ISO 27001/27002 (ISMS), 27701 (PIMS), 27014 (IS Governance) and 29134 (PIA) to standards for specific domains such as IEC 62443 (OT), ISO 28001 (SCM), 42001 (AIMS), 38505 (Data Governance), 23576 & 23244 (Blockchain and distributed ledger technologies).

This course offers an extensive introduction to the practices and regulations of information security, designed to equip students with a thorough understanding of the international standards governing information security and industry best practices. Our primary goal is to ensure learners acquire a deep and comprehensive knowledge of how to maintain security and privacy in various organizational contexts, guided by globally recognized standards. Throughout the course, we will cover a broad spectrum of security and privacy-oriented standards, including:

-	ISO 27001/27002 for Information Security Management Systems (ISMS),
-	ISO 27701 for Privacy Information Management Systems (PIMS),
-	ISO 27014 for Information Security Governance,
-	ISO 29134 for Privacy Impact Assessment (PIA),
-	Other domain-specific standards such as IEC 62443 (OT), ISO 28001 (SCM), ISO 42001 (AIMS), ISO 38505 (Data Governance), and ISO 23576 & 23244 (Blockchain and distributed ledger technologies).

This curriculum is carefully crafted to not only present theoretical knowledge but also to provide practical insights of these standards, preparing students for the real-world challenges they will face in the information security field.

crs_outline:
Visual computing transitioned from traditional image processing that relied on manual feature engineering to representation learning driven by deep neural networks. This transition has allowed machines to achieve unprecedented accuracy in visual recognition tasks, while simultaneously introducing challenges regarding computational efficiency, model interpretability, and multimodal reasoning. This course bridges foundational deep learning algorithms with forward-looking real-world deployments such as autonomous systems and digital healthcare.
The primary objective of this course is understanding deep learning across diverse core vision tasks, including image classification, semantic segmentation, image retrieval, and generative synthesis. We will explore limitations such as the heavy reliance on massive annotated datasets, bias amplification, and the inherent "black box" opacity of neural network architectures. Furthermore, introducing the frontier of AI, covering the integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) and Vision-Language Models (VLMs). The synthesis of visual and textual modalities enables systems to transition from mere pattern recognition to complex compositional reasoning, spatial logic, and agentic interactions. To ensure practical viability, the course examines edge computing optimization such as model pruning for deploying highly parameterized models onto resource-constrained hardware.

crs_outline: With the achievements of nanotechnology and nanoscience, a wide variety of nanoscale materials and devices with different sizes (1–100 nm), shapes, and compositions have been introduced to biosensing. The small sizes of nanoparticles and nanodevices break through the limitation of structure miniaturization, leading to a lower detection limit, even reaching zeptomolar concentrations. Based on fundamentals of theories, aside from optical biosensing, this course introduces and emphysizes novel principles and detection strategies in biosensing for nanomaterials and nanodevices. Each topic provides a theoretical overview of different topics like potentialmetric, amperometric and cantilever-based nanosings, and the correspondent interesting bioanalytical applications. The most exciting and unique aspect of this course is that the utilization of nanomaterials and nanodevices not only enhances the biosensing capabilities, but also brings out newer approaches such as reagent-less biosensing, label-free biosensing, and single molecular detection.

crs_outline:
邊緣人工智慧：邊緣人~工作的智慧？邊緣人工~的智慧？邊緣的~人工智慧！

不管怎麼解讀，概念都離不開 efficient (高效率) 這個詞，尤其對 CS 領域的邊緣人來說，能躺著幹就不坐起來，能坐著幹就不站起來，實為 efficient 一詞的極致表現。身為 CS 領域的(邊緣)人，如果你對人工智慧有興趣，但不想再調參建模了，此課必修！

========
當人工智慧越來越普及，越來越多的人工智慧服務將被去中心化，也就是邊緣化，邊緣化的人工智慧服務仰賴邊緣(終端)裝置獨立運作，可不仰賴網路連接至大型雲端伺服器或資料中心，更不須分享機敏資料。相較於集中式的、雲端的人工智慧服務，邊緣化的人工智慧服務(此後簡稱為邊緣人工智慧)有以下幾項優點：
1. 高隱私性、無機敏資料洩漏之疑慮
2. 無(低)網路需求、不受網路頻寬影響
3. 無(低)雲端伺服器或資料中心之需求

但天下沒有白吃的午餐，想當邊緣人，凡事就得自己來；想擁有邊緣人工智慧的優點，凡事只能靠在地的、非雲端的邊緣(終端)裝置。然而，終端裝置通常不具備大規模運算能力，沒有充沛的記憶體資源，且可能沒有穩定的電力來源甚至僅依賴電池供電。因此，邊緣人工智慧的運行，必須高效率，更精確地說，軟體(人工智慧之模型)要小巧但準確，硬體(運行人工智慧之裝置)要又快又省電，缺一不可。

這門課將探討一系列為了實現「邊緣人工智慧」的相關技術，詳細內容請看下面的進度列表。

(1) Enable students to participate directly in corporate R＆amp;amp;D and project workflows, applying theoretical knowledge learned in class to real-world practice.
(2) Develop professional skills such as programming, system design, data processing, testing, and debugging.
(3) Strengthen cross-department collaboration, time management, communication skills, and workplace ethics.
(4) Build the ability to produce complete R＆amp;amp;D documentation and present project outcomes, thereby enhancing overall employability and competitiveness.

dep_ename: Master Program in Transdisciplinary LongTerm Care and Management
crs_outline:
課程描述:
    本課程在使學生能獲得社區衛生護理的概念，了解社區衛生護理工作的專業內涵，同時體認社區護理的角色與功能。在實務上是以家庭為單位，社區整體為服務對象，從三段五級預防的角度，應用適當的評估工具、介入措施與資源，了解個人家庭與社區的健康問題，協助個人家庭與社區了解、處理其健康問題，進而達到最高層次健康的目標。
課程目標:
1. 了解社區衛生護理之定義、現況、角色功能與趨勢。
2. 認識社區護理之理論與實務。
3. 認識家庭健康評估與家庭護理知識與方法。
4. 分析個人、家庭、團體與社區健康需要的評估原則、方法與措施。
5. 應用社區健康計畫的目標、原則與方法。
6. 綜合生命史各階段族群之健康問題與護理措施。

dep_cname: 跨專業長期照顧與管理碩士學位學程
dep_ename: Master Program in Transdisciplinary LongTerm Care and Management
crs_outline:
一、課程概述：
介紹何謂長照，國內長期照護的現況、問題、與解決方案，本課程旨在先透過長期照顧體系來瞭解台灣與不同國家現行的長照政策，以讓學生對於長照政策具基本認識。後續將從重要長照議題切入，來探討不同政策與解決策略之內容與影響，對現存政策與策略，提出具體可行的建議，並提出對長期照護服務未來發展與新趨勢的建言。本課程希望學生可以全球視野全面了解長期照護體系，以培養獨立思考和決策的能力。 

二、學習目標：
課程結束學生能
1. 瞭解國內外現行之長照服務體系。
2. 分析長照政策法令與策略在高齡社會的重要性。
3. 瞭解長照政策之形成的過程與影響(政策問題、方案、行動、結果與實行)。
4. 瞭解分析長照財務、科技輔具、安寧緩和、高齡友善食品、失智症與長照移工等政策與特定議題。
5. 分析長照服務體系、政策與策略在前述特定議題之適當性。
6.了解分析不同專業在特定長照議題之角色與功能。
7. 瞭解長照體系與政策法令，對個人、家庭、社區、社會與國家的影響。

dep_cname: 跨專業長期照顧與管理碩士學位學程
dep_ename: Master Program in Transdisciplinary LongTerm Care and Management
crs_outline:
一、課程概述：
配合學程課程規劃，學生將透過本實習課程，整合醫學、護理、社會、人文等學科知識，參與長期照顧實務，並與各領域團隊成員協調合作。學生在實習過程中，以生態理論架構，了解現行長照政策與策略、服務體系、照顧模式與措施、服務個案及其重要關係人之問題及其相關之生理心理社會及環境相關因素，並進一步分析實習單位特定現有(潛在)長期照護議題，研擬具體可行之方案，並在執行及評值過程中，修正優化方案內容，以改善實習單位現有(潛在)照護議題。

二、課程目標：
1.了解實習單位的設立目標、業務特色與服務族群。
2.了解與實習單位有關之長照政策與策略， 及該單位在長照服務體系之角色、功能。
3. 了解實習單位之業務與服務模式、服務對象及其重要關係人之問題及之相關因素。
4.了解實習單位中各職類工作人員的專業角色及功能。
5.分析實習單位或個案現存或潛在之問題、困難與影響因素。
6.針對單位現有(潛在)議題，研擬具體可行之方案。
7.執行並評值照護議題之方案。

crs_outline:
本課程介紹生物統計學的核心概念與方法，內容涵蓋研究設計、資料探索、機率分配、點估計與區間估計，並進一步討論假說檢定、變異數分析、線性與羅吉斯迴歸、類別資料分析及無母數方法。課程亦結合R統計軟體（R或R Commander）實作，以培養實務資料分析和解讀能力。
This course introduces the core concepts and methods of biostatistics, covering study design, exploratory data, probability distributions, point and interval estimation, and further topics such as hypothesis testing, analysis of variance, linear and logistic regression, categorical data analysis and nonparametric method. The course also incorporates practice with R statistical software to develop practical data analysis skills.

Ed. 2010. 課程內容深入討論了男性生殖健康的所有方面，包括基本生理男性的生殖功能和廣泛影響的疾病障礙。其中涉及的議題包括： 睾丸功能、精子成熟和受精、不孕及性腺功能低下症診斷程序、勃起障礙、男性學相關疾病及遺傳性疾病、環境的影響、睾丸激素治療、不孕症之經驗療法、男性避孕、男性老化問題。同時提供臨床上經驗分享，有助於所有關注男性生殖健康的相關專業人員，包括基礎科學家等。The class covers all aspects of the male reproductive systems, including diseases and effects of aging and up-to-date coverage of assisted reproduction and erectile dysfunction. The essential reference book in the class, both for beginners and experts, is “ Andrology: male reproductive health and dysfunction. 3rd. Ed. 2010. ” It examines in depth all aspects of male reproductive health, encompassing the basic physiology of male reproductive function and a wide range of disorders. Among the topics covered are: Testicular function、Sperm maturation and fertilization、Diagnostic procedures of Infertility and Late-onset hypogonadism、Erectile dysfunction、Genetic disorders、Environmental influences、Testosterone therapy、Assisted reproduction: TESE and ICSI、Cryopreservation、Male contraception、Aging Male, etc. The experienced physician will also provide with a valuable reference work. It will appeal to all who are concerned with male reproductive health, including basic scientists.

crs_outline: 本課程是為非生物背景(例如資訊、統計等)的同學設計，讓同學能瞭解重要的觀念、名詞、與學習工具或重要資料庫的使用方式。雖然還是有部份名詞需要死記，但整體上希望同學在有了名詞的基礎後，能很快地在教科書上、網際網路上找到適當的資源，解決問題，或指導AI開發程式。因此，上課時會直接告訴同學那些名詞需要背，並強調觀念的學習與尚未被解的難題，方便同學發現創新的方向。課程中會透過討論的方式，導引同學利用AI收集資料，並判斷回答的真偽，希望培養同學應用這些知識、與自我學習的方法。

memo: 開放大學部選修。
crs_outline: 隨著高通量基因體技術的快速發展，生物醫學研究已累積大量基因表現(Gene Expression)資料，如何從海量且高維度的基因體數據中萃取具生物意義的資訊，已成為精準醫療、生物資訊及人工智慧應用的重要課題。本課程以微陣列(Microarray)基因表現資料分析為主軸，系統性介紹基因體資料分析流程，從資料前處理、差異表現基因偵測、統計假說檢定、資料視覺化，到功能富集分析等核心內容。課程中特別著重於如何從高維度基因體資料中進行特徵選取(Feature Selection)，並進一步運用分群分析(Clustering)與機器學習(Machine Learning)分類模型(Classification)進行疾病診斷、生物標記(Biomarker)發掘及預測模型建構。

dep_cname: 跨專業長期照顧與管理碩士學位學程
dep_ename: Master Program in Transdisciplinary LongTerm Care and Management
crs_outline:
Course Description
This course is designed for students to understand and identify the basic principles and processes of group psychotherapy. Specific issues such as therapeutic factors, development of a group, selection of patients, and problem patients, will also be introduced. Specialized forms of groups related to clinical practice and research such as cognitive behavior therapy and focus group will be addressed. In order to enhance the experience to practice group therapy, one practice section will be added.  
Group therapy has a wide range of applications in long-term care. For example: for cases with mental health problems, psychiatric disorders, dementia, etc. in residential or community-based long-term care facilities. Furthermore, cognitive-behavior therapy has been demonstrated to be effective for a range of mental or physical problems. Students taking this class are expected to learn how to apply group therapy to long-term care practice and research. 

Course Objectives
On completion of this course, students will be able to:
1. Identify principles of group dynamics, including components of group process, developmental stages of a group, and individual and group goal-setting.
2. Know group members’ roles and behaviors, and the therapeutic factors of group work.
3. Understand group leadership styles and approaches, including characteristics of various types of group leaders and the relationship between leadership styles and group functioning.
4. Understand theories of group counseling, including commonalities, distinguishing characteristics, and pertinent research and literature.
5. Compare and contrast different group counseling methods, including group counselor orientations and behaviors, appropriate selection criteria and methods, group structuring and facilitation skills, and methods for evaluation of group growth and effectiveness.

crs_outline:
這門課是醫學倫理與法律的入門課。雖然近年來人工智慧、大數據、基因編輯等科技發展引發許多倫理疑慮，但追根究底都跟隱私、生命、身體自主及人性尊嚴等核心價值的衝突有關。這些核心價值面臨科技的衝擊不是頭一遭，每一次的遭遇，都會促使我們更深刻地反省這些核心價值的意義，確保它們歷久彌新又能與時俱進。因此我們會從末期照護、基因檢測與篩檢、生育、器官移植等比較成熟的議題，先引導學生反省這些核心價值在當代與科技衝擊下的意義，再帶領同學反思人工智慧、大數據、基因編輯等新科技對這些核心價值的衝擊與意義，並且尋找新的界限。
課程結束時，希望同學能夠磨練出以下能力：
1. 對倫理的敏感度
2. 價值衝突的分析能力與解決能力
3. 呈現自己價值立場的論述能力
4. 彼此傾聽與對話的能力
This is an introductory course for bioethics and law.  We will start with classic cases in bioethics to help student understand the development and core values of bioethics, and move on to reflect upon how we should maintain the core values of bioethics in development of of big data, artificial intelligence and CRISPR.  By the end of the course, we how that students can be more sensitive toward potential ethical issues, be more able to present ethical arguments, and be more able to listen to different opinions with better ability for ethical diagolue.

cos_ename: Artificial Intelligence for Biomedical Data, Signal, and Image
crs_outline: The course is designed to provide students with a comprehensive understanding of machine learning and deep learning theories that are specifically tailored for practical applications. The course will delve into the realm of AI and its potential applications in healthcare and will feature case studies that demonstrate real-world applications such as infoepidemiology during and post-COVID era, the hearing smart medical system, which leverages AI algorithms to analyze patient data and provide personalized treatment plans based on their hearing loss. The course will also demonstrate how AI can be used to predict heart failure risk from hemodialysis data and how mass spectrometry-based proteomics can be used. By using medical data examples, the course will highlight the potential and limitations of these techniques and provide students with a deep understanding of how these techniques can be applied in real-world settings. The course will also explore real-world implementations that involve various data processing methods, model development, and optimization strategies, providing students with a hands-on approach to learning. Overall, the course is an excellent opportunity for students to gain a comprehensive understanding of AI and its potential healthcare applications and explore the latest developments in machine learning and deep learning theories tailored for practical applications.

crs_outline:
一、課程簡介
醫療社會學為衛生福利研究所社會學與福利專業理論課程之核心專業課程之一，也是世界各大醫學院與公共衛生學院重要的選修課程。本課程將結合醫療社會學理論及實務，將醫療實務現場中所面臨的醫療社會學議題介紹給修課同學，增加研究量能。本課程為研究取向，全部課程由老師講授，介紹醫療社會學中的經典研究範例，並介紹老師自己的相關研究，並指出未來的研究方向，學習目標是希望增進修課同學如何透過醫療社會開啟或創新自己的研究量能，而不是講授教科書各章節基本知識。
二、課程目標
1. 學習醫療社會學的定義、基本概念、理論，包括古典、後現代及當代理論的發展。
2. 學習醫療社會學對於衛生福利研究之可能意涵。
3. 運用醫療社會學概念於衛生福利學術研究創新、開啟新的研究方向，並為衛生福利政策帶來更多思
考及研究元素。
三、課程要求：
本課程為學術與研究討論課程，需尊重各種不同專業之間的觀點。

crs_outline: 口述歷史是最直接深入的與人接觸方式，敘事學的興起則是晚近人文社會學科受到後現代主義影響後，對理論的普遍性產生質疑進而引發新的問學方式，人們稱之為人文社會學科的敘事轉向，這個學術風潮也影響到醫學與生命倫理學的變革，搭配著醫院裡的哲學家所伴隨的臨床倫理諮詢學科的興起，敘事倫理成為當代醫學與人文社會學科所共同發展出來的新學術典範。可是什麼是合適的敘事倫理方法，卻有著多種見解，可說是諸多學科所共同面對的挑戰，不同領域也有各自摸索的取徑與成果。透過廣泛人文社會學科探索，這門課結合口述歷史與與敘事倫理，期待幫助同學透過口述歷史的方法學實踐，反思攸關敘事倫理的理論思考與範例，為台灣發展中的臨床倫理諮詢與生命倫理學，奠立一個由本地歷史文化經驗出發，又能與當代文明思潮接軌的知識生產與實踐方式。

cos_cname: 細胞胞器與現代腦科學
memo: 1.本堂課將會以同步遠距教學方式上課，同學可提早5分鐘進入虛擬教室(ZOOM)準備上課，連結每周會公告於E3系統上。2.開放大學部選修、隨班附讀
crs_outline:
此課程將利用ZOOM或Google Meet 網路平台，透過即時連線同步授課的方式，讓陽明校區與交大校區的同學們可以在課堂中互相討論。
我們會從最基礎的細胞胞器出發，帶領同學們了解其基本功能與近期研究之後，再深入探討這些胞器在最新神經科學領域的發現，提供同學們重新思索腦疾病的潛在治療方式。
期待同學們修習本課程後，可以對以下的內容有更深的認識：
1.	理解神經細胞中主要細胞器的結構與功能：我們會從神經細胞中常見的胞器開始，如粒線體（mitochondria）、內質網（endoplasmic reticulum）、高基氏體（Golgi apparatus）、溶酶體（lysosome）及神經纖毛(Neuronal cilium)等細胞器，探討它們在神經元中的特化角色。
2.	討細胞器失調與神經疾病之關聯：我們預期會討論各種胞器失調與神經疾病之間的關係。如粒線體功能障礙、自噬異常（autophagy dysfunction）等如何導致如阿茲海默症（Alzheimer’s disease）、巴金森氏症（Parkinson’s disease）等神經退化疾病。
3.	掌握研究細胞器功能的現代實驗技術：我們在課程中也會讓同學們熟悉如螢光顯微技術（fluorescence microscopy）、活細胞影像（live-cell imaging）、電子顯微鏡（electron microscopy）及分子生物學方法的應用。
4.	批判性閱讀與分析科學文獻：我們會藉由論文討論的過程，讓同學們能夠理解並評析當代神經科學與細胞器研究的期刊論文，培養獨立思考與學術討論能力。
5.	整合跨尺度知識以解釋神經系統功能：我們預期將分子與細胞層級的細胞器功能連結至神經迴路與行為表現，建立跨層次理解。

crs_outline: This course offers a comprehensive introduction to data analysis with a strong emphasis on real-world biomedical and clinical applications. Designed specifically for students in biomedical informatics, it equips learners with the analytical skills needed to extract meaningful insights from complex health and biological datasets. The course begins with foundational data analysis techniques to uncover relationships and associations within biomedical data, followed by statistical visualization methods — including summary statistics and graphical plots — to effectively communicate findings. Students will then explore inferential statistics for both numeric and categorical data, with examples drawn from clinical trials, genomics, and electronic health records. The latter half of the course covers data exploration, preprocessing, and regression modeling, with an emphasis on translational applications in precision medicine and public health. Combining lectures with hands-on programming exercises, this course prepares students to confidently tackle data-driven challenges in biomedical research. Assessment includes analytic exercises, a course project, and a final implementation project in which students apply learned techniques to a biomedical dataset of their choice.

crs_outline:
本課程將帶領同學從最基礎的分子生物學出發，一步步理解大腦與神經系統研究背後的核心原理。課程首先介紹基因如何透過轉錄與轉譯形成蛋白質，並認識現代神經科學研究中常用的基因轉殖與基因剔除小鼠技術（兩小時）。透過這些內容，同學將能理解科學家如何操控基因，進一步探索腦功能與疾病機制。在建立基因與蛋白質的基本概念後，課程將進一步介紹蛋白質的結構與功能，以及神經科學研究中常見的重要實驗技術，例如西方墨點法（Western blot）與免疫螢光染色法（一小時），幫助同學了解研究人員如何「看見」細胞中的分子變化。接著，課程將深入介紹動物細胞的基本結構，包括細胞核、細胞膜、細胞質及各種胞器，並聚焦於神經系統中的各類細胞，例如不同類型的神經元與膠質細胞，探討它們在大腦中的功能與差異（三小時）。除了認識神經細胞的結構，本課程也將帶領同學探索神經元如何傳遞訊息，包括神經訊息傳導(一個半小時)與動作電位的產生原理，以及這些機制如何應用於睡眠研究等重要腦科學議題（一個半小時）。透過實際研究案例，同學將能體會基礎神經科學如何連結到真實世界的重要問題。課程後半部將介紹動物模式在腦科學中的應用（三小時），以及顯微鏡的基本原理與觀察方法（三小時），讓同學對現代神經科學研究工具建立完整而具體的認識。整體而言，本課程希望帶領完全沒有生物學背景的腦科所新生，從分子、細胞到系統層次，建立對實驗神經科學的整體概念。不僅協助同學銜接未來進階課程，更希望激發同學對腦科學研究的興趣與探索動機。
This course will guide students step-by-step through the fundamentals of molecular biology to understand the core principles behind brain and nervous system. The course begins by introducing how genes form proteins through transcription and translation and introduces genetic engineering tools commonly used in neuroscience research (2 hours). Through this content, students will understand how scientists manipulate genes to further explore brain function and disease mechanisms. After establishing the basic concepts of genes and proteins, the course will further introduce the structure and function of proteins, as well as important experimental techniques commonly used in neuroscience research, such as Western blot and immunofluorescence staining (1 hour), enabling students to understand how researchers "see" molecular changes in cells. Next, the course will delve into the basic structure of animal cells, including the nucleus, cell membrane, cytoplasm, and various organelles. We will focus on different types of cells in the nervous system, such as neurons and glial cells, exploring their functions and differences in the brain (3 hours). Beyond understanding the structure of brain cells, this course will guide students to explore how neurons transmit information, including the principles of signal transduction (1.5 hours) and the generation of action potentials, as well as how these mechanisms are applied to important neuroscience topics, using sleep research as an example (1.5 hours). Through real-world research case studies, students will gain an understanding of how fundamental neuroscience connects to crucial questions. The latter half of the course will introduce the application of animal models in neuroscience (3 hours) and the basic principles of microscopy (3 hours), providing students with a comprehensive and concrete understanding of tools applied in neuroscience research. Overall, this course aims to guide new brain science students with no prior biology background to develop a holistic understanding of experimental neuroscience, from molecular and cellular levels to systemic levels. It not only assists students in transitioning to future advanced courses but also aims to stimulate their interest and motivation in neuroscience research.

crs_outline: 本課程旨在探討如何在統計科學中超越單純相關性，進一步理解變數之間的影響關係。課程聚焦於臨床試驗與觀察性研究中效果的估計與解釋，並介紹以潛在結果與圖形模型為基礎的分析架構。內容涵蓋混雜調整方法，包括後門準則、前門準則、G 估計、傾向分數與工具變數等方法。課程並結合 R 語言之實際資料分析，強化理論與實務的連結，培養學生在效果評估、假設檢驗與混雜處理上的分析能力。This course aims to go beyond simple correlations and develop a statistical framework for understanding relationships among variables. It focuses on the estimation and interpretation of effects in clinical trials and observational studies, introducing analytical frameworks based on potential outcomes and graphical models. Topics include methods for confounding adjustment, such as back-door and front-door criteria, G-estimation, propensity score methods, and instrumental variables. Real data applications using R are incorporated to bridge theory and practice, enhancing students’ skills in effect estimation, hypothesis testing, and confounding control.

本課程旨在引導學生深入了解生物統計與資料科學領域之重要研究議題與最新發展，並培養批判性閱讀學術文獻及獨立思考之能力。課程透過文獻研討、研究成果分享及專題交流，探討統計推論、資料分析方法與人工智慧技術在公共衛生、生物醫學及健康照護研究中的應用。

cos_cname: Python機器學習在智慧醫療的應用
memo: 管理與政策必選修之一，非醫管所學生需取得授課老師同意。
cos_ename: Python Machine Learning for Smart Healthcare
dep_ename: Institute of Hospital and Health Care Administration
crs_outline:
透過人工智能的技術，來輔助醫療人員在臨床上做判讀、診斷、開藥、甚至是預警，已成為近年來醫院發展重點之一。人工智能的核心技術是「機器學習」。本課程的目標是給有興趣對機器學習一探究竟的醫學院學生們一個入門的管道：從基本的Python程式語言教起，透過醫療數據的實例，特別是影像數據與文字數據，以實作的方式帶領學生進入「機器學習」的世界，最後讓學生們進入「機器學習」中目前最熱門的領域「 深度學習」。
Artificial Intelligence has shown great success in a wide range of smart healthcare and public health applications, from diagnosis and prescription suggestions, patient monitoring, disease prediction, to pandemic spread prediction. The goal of this introductory course is to provide an entry point for students who are interested in applying AI to solving healthcare related problems. We will start from Python programming basics, proceed to Machine Learning using real-world healthcare data, including medical images and clinical notes, and then enter the world of Deep Learning, the hottest subfield of Machine Learning.

dep_ename: Institute of Hospital and Health Care Administration
crs_outline:
本課程旨在培育學生理解醫療機構運作模式，掌握醫療管理決策與流程治理核心原則，同時建立資安風險評估、資安架構設計與法規遵循能力。學生將學習如何依據衛生政策發展與變革，結合並運用管理工具、策略與資訊安全框架，強化醫療服務品質、資料保護與組織韌性，培養跨部門協作與治理規劃的實務能力。
本課程結合衛生政策、醫務管理與醫院設計治理，並運用商業智慧，Business Intelligence（BI）技術於系統環境建置、資料分析與治理機制之中。學生將培養醫療政策規劃、管理決策與組織治理的實務能力。本課程亦涵蓋資訊安全法規、治理模式、管理框架與技術執行方法，以強化流程規劃、組織韌性，以及資料與系統的安全性。
本課程亦對應 Association of University Programs in Health Administration (AUPHA) 與 Commission on the Accreditation of Healthcare Management Education (CAHME) 的 Domain 10 與 Domain 24。

cos_ename: Algorithmic Mechanism Design and Social Choice
dep_ename: Institute of Hospital and Health Care Administration
crs_outline:
課程概述與目標：
Algorithmic game theory and learning sprouts as an active interdisciplinary field integrating computer science and economics. While its impacting contributions, namely, the efficiency of equilibria and complexity of computing equilibria are more on the measurement and analysis side of equilibria, treating equilibria as an engineerable aggregated choice, “algorithmic mechanism design and social choice” which is more on the engineering side also develops promisingly in parallel and produces lots of interesting and well-unknown results. Based on the classical results in mechanism design and social choice in economics, our goals are introducing various mechanism design questions and topics from computational and algorithmic perspectives, complementary to  algorithmic game theory and learning.

It will address the principles of the quantitative approach to clinical and public health problems. The course will discuss measures of disease frequency and association, and introduce the design and validity of epidemiologic research. dep_ename: Institute of Environmental and Occupational Health Sciences
crs_outline:
概述：
環境與職場經常暴露有害質物質，因此可能影響民眾與工作者之健康。風險評估基本架構包含危害鑑定、劑量反應、暴露評估及風險特性，其中，暴露評估為本課程傳授之主題，分為二部分:環境暴露評估與職業暴露評估[定性或(半)定量方法評估勞工暴露於化學品之健康危害情形]。探討族群包括一般民眾(含易感族群)與職場工作者。暴露情境包括，一般日常生活環境(攝食、個人保養品與藥物)與職場經由飲食、吸入與皮膚接觸暴露環境/職場(新興)污染物與毒物，分為(1)認知:環境與職場危害因子之多重暴露源、毒理機轉與健康效應；(2)評估:利用環境測定與生物偵測手段，同時串聯環境與職場(新興)污染物前處理與分析，與(3)討論環境與職場污染物暴露評估之實例。
目標：
1.瞭解暴露評估學理與技術，學習各種危害性評估之模式運用於環境與職業衛生實務界
2.暴露評估實際應用於各種環境與職業衛生之問題

cos_cname: 蛋白質降解特論-中草藥於疾病治療的相關機制
memo: 開放大學部大三以上與研究所跨所選修
cos_ename: Special Topic on Protein Degradation - The mechanisms of Chinese herbal medicine on diseases therapy
crs_outline:
蛋白質降解是細胞中不可或缺的重要機制之一，其係經由一系列反應將蛋白質等進行瓦解成小片段胜肽或胺基酸，以利細胞再度回收重新製作出新蛋白質。然而，現今許多研究發現蛋白質降解系統的異常，往往會造成許多疾病發生，如癌症。本課程將介紹各式蛋白質降解機制並深入探討如何結合應用蛋白質降解機制探討中草藥研究於各式疾病治療之新穎策略。

Protein degradation is one of the most important mechanisms in cells. It uses a series of reactions to promote the proteins to digest into small fragments of peptide or amino acids, which can be used to produce a new protein. However, many studies show abnormalities in protein degradation systems often cause many diseases, such as cancer. This course will introduce a variety of protein degradation mechanisms and explore how use protein degradation systems to develop new strategies for various diseases treatment by Chinese herbal medicine.

本課程專為環境衛生與毒理學領域之碩士班研究生設計 ，旨在建構兼具「現代分子毒理研究方法」、「臨床器官疾病模式」與「國際法規風險評估」的系統性認知。
課程教學目標:
1.掌握現代毒理研究技術： 熟練掌握從細胞培養測試到多層次分子生物學（DNA/RNA/蛋白質）的現代毒理學研究與篩檢方法 。

3.了解法規試驗與安全評估： 熟悉國際化學品危害辨識、急慢性毒性規範，以及全球法規架構下對於吸入、皮膚、眼睛與生態毒性的標準測試指引（OECD TG） 。

1.	掌握最新研究主題、技術方法與成果

crs_outline:
Course descriptions and objectives:
(1) The purpose of this class is to encourage students to listen, to read, to speak and to write in English on various topics in sciences.
(2) We will use YouTube films, word and PDF files, each of us need to do our homework before we come to class so that we know what we are going to discuss in the class.
(3) This is an in person/online class, we will use Google meet, so you can use your cellular phone, your computer or your iPad to join our class discussion. Make sure that your camera and microphone is on so that we can see you and hear you.
(4) The class is designed to give you a chance to explore your potential, you need to try to speak up, overcome your fear of speaking in English. No one can help you if you do not try.
(5) Respect is one thing we need to do in this class. Regardless of our religion, political party preference, sex or gender, we will have the same right to speak. When one of us is talking, show respect to the speaker by not interfere or interrupt him/her, each one of us is entitled to our own opinion. You can share your point of view when it is your turn.
(6) Each class is 100 minutes and will be separated into 4 sections (25 minutes/section). There will be a 5 minute break between each section. We may show some short videos during the class to stimulate discussion, if you need to go to the bathroom or get something to eat or drink, just come back to class ASAP. Each time when one talks, there is a limit of 5 minutes, we will remind you around 4 minutes so that you can wrap it up in one minute. This way other students can have a chance to talk.
(7) It is okay if you had a bad day and you don't feel like talking or let others to see your sad face. However, we do have a suggestion for you to consider, one thing you can do is to "fake it", just pretend you had a wonderful day and you're in a good mood and join our discussion. If you can do that, you will get extra credits because "practice makes perfect." Who knows, maybe one day you will become a famous actor/actress because you discovered your potential in this class.

人類的無數疾病皆造始於發炎反應 (inflammatory reaction)，包括感染症、藥物過敏、自體免疫病，及腫瘤侵犯引起的發炎。而免疫學研究即是了解啟動發炎反應的機制，以發展生物製劑來治癒人類的病痛。透過鑑定出各種「先天免疫受體」的抗原及所發展出來各種單株抗體及基因工程蛋白，不但具有極大的學術價值，也帶來無限商機。
Inflammatory reaction is the root cause for countless human diseases, including infectious diseases, drug-induced hypersensitivity, autoimmune diseases, and cancer invasion. Identifying antigens specific for different types of innate immunity receptors and developing corresponding monoclonal antibodies and genetically engineered proteins will not only be of great academic achievement, but will also create countless business opportunities.

cos_ename: Study design and data analysis for clinical research
crs_outline: 臨床醫學研究設計與資料分析是執行臨床研究與轉譯醫學重要的學問之一，除了資料的收集、分析、闡釋、及資料的呈現，對於臨床研究者的計畫執行與發表，都是缺一不可的重要項目。本課程前半段回顧初等醫學統計，使學生了解在不同的資料形態之下，應該使用何種醫學統計方法進行假說檢定；而在後半段則介紹不同的臨床研究設計方式，幫助學生未來進行臨床醫學研究。課程中佐以應用統計軟體(SAS)，使學生除了課程的學習也能兼具實務的應用。

teacher: 林嘉澍、洪凱風、陳翾、曾柏鈞
memo: 全英語授課[English Medium Course]
cos_ename: Practical skills and AI applications for Oral Medicine Research
crs_outline:
牙醫學院各系所碩博士班同學由於大學背景各異，或偏向臨床治療而不熟悉學術研究基本方法，對於新科技的使用也不甚靈活(或誤用)。因此亟需各種研究基礎實務訓練(包括學術倫理與論文撰寫)，特別是正確，高效使用AI工具的觀念與技能，是維繫高品質教學與研究的基礎。因此本課程將對下列四項主題，提升研究生應用AI的研究技能。

The graduate students from the College of Dentistry have a great diversity in their background. Clinical students are not familiar with basic research skills and may misuse digital and AI technology. Therefore, a comprehensive training on basic skills of research, including research ethics and thesis preparation, and how to use AI tools decently and effectively, plays a key role in high-quality research training. This course will promote the students’ skills with the following teaching objectives.

教學目標：
1.	了解碩博士班學位論文之基本要求與使用AI工具的基本原則
2.	演練AI工具對完成學位考試的各項應用　
3.	演練AI工具發表論文成果的應用
4.	熟悉AI工具對產學研發的應用

Teaching objectives
1.	Understanding the basic requirements of a research thesis and the principles of using AI tools.
2.	Practicing AI tools for thesis preparation.
3.	Practicing AI tools for research publication
4.	Understanding the applications of AI in Industry-Academia collaboration

cos_cname: 次世代定序與生物資訊分析
memo: [English Medium Course]
crs_outline:
The objective of this course is to teach students comprehensive and practical knowledge of next-generation sequencing (NGS), ranging from sequencing technology, library preparation, and data analysis. Students will be given a clear overview of bioinformatics for genome mapping, variant calling, RNA transcriptomics, and microbiome analysis. At the end of the course, participants will be able to independently analyze NGS data on organisms with reference genomes.

本課程的目標在於教導學生關於次世代定序之完整且實務的知識，包含定序技術、建庫實驗、以及資料分析。學生將習得生物資訊於基因體回䩞、變異點偵測、RNA 轉錄體、以及微生物菌相之分析。修習完本課程之後，在具有參考基因體序列的前提下，參與者將擁有獨立分析次世代定序資料的能力。

crs_outline:
This 18-week course introduces students to basic principles and emerging concepts in stem cell biology and the clinical applications of stem cells. The course aims to provide students with a foundation that will enable them to investigate the therapeutic application of stem cells in different tissues and organs.

Intended Learning Outcomes
(1) To identify ESC, iPSC, and adult stem cell
(2) To explain the protocols of cell preparation and transportation
(3) To illustrate at least three ongoing clinical cell therapies/trials and cell therapy regulation in Taiwan
(4) To compare the advantages and disadvantages among ESC, iPSC, and MSC
(5) To describe side effects of clinical cell therapy
(6) To design a clinical trial (final presentation and written assignment)
(7) To appraise the clinical trial designed by other classmates

crs_outline:
本課程是歷年於牙醫學系開設並頗受好評之「行為實驗設計與文獻整合分析」課程，特為生物科技與工程領域同學開設的應用性質課程。有別於大部分側重臨床實驗設計與文獻整合分析等方法理論的課程，本課程特別側重使用生成式AI工具探索研究主題與設計實驗。

教學目標：
1.	認識以生成式AI為基礎的學術文獻搜尋與整合工具並熟悉使用方式。
2.	認識傳統臨床文獻搜尋與實驗設計的基本概念
3.	區辨使用生成式AI協助文獻搜尋與研究設計之時機與限制

This course is tailored for students in the fields of biotechnology and engineering, based on the highly acclaimed course "Behavioral Experiment Design and Literature Integration Analysis" taught in the Department of Dentistry. While most courses with a similar topic focus on clinical research design and methodology of systematic review, this course will emphasize the use of generative AI tools to explore research topics and design research.

Teaching objectives
1.	Learn the major AI-based tools for academic literature search and how to use them.
2.	Learn the basic concepts of clinical literature search and experimental design.
3.	Identify the pros and cons as well as limitations of using generative AI to assist in literature search and research design.

crs_outline:
Course Description
The goal of this course is to enable students to translate philosophical and theoretical perspectives into good research methodologies. It critically raises questions about the choice, role and value of quantitative methodology and the manner in which this influences data collection, analysis, interpretation and writing up. Research designs and related statistical analyses are explored with respect to their appropriateness for addressing disciplinary problems. The specific models introduced will be chosen based on students’ research topics.

Course Objectives
At the completion of this course, the students will be able to:
1.	Critically assess the methods of data collection in quantitative research;
2.	Achieve advanced understanding of various research designs and data collection approaches,
3.	Examine the various uses of quantitative data
4.	Apply this knowledge in the formulation of a research question and research proposal.

crs_outline:
這堂課程將引導學生從基礎走向前沿，系統性地建立對口腔組織工程的整體視野與臨床應用潛力的認知。課程內容不僅涵蓋細胞生物學、免疫學與材料科學的核心原理，還將強調如何將這些學科整合，形成跨領域的思維框架。
        學生將深入了解仿生材料設計與細胞操作技術，特別是如何透過調控細胞外基質與免疫微環境，驅動組織再生與免疫調控。此外，課程會探討組織工程在口腔相關疾病治療的發展，並連結至再生醫學與免疫工程的最新研究趨勢。
    This course will guide students from foundational concepts to cutting-edge developments, fostering a systematic understanding of oral tissue engineering and its clinical application potential. The curriculum not only covers the core principles of cell biology, immunology, and materials science, but also emphasizes the integration of these disciplines to cultivate an interdisciplinary framework of thinking.
    Students will gain in-depth knowledge of biomimetic material design and cellular manipulation techniques, with particular focus on how modulation of the extracellular matrix and immune microenvironment can drive tissue regeneration and immune regulation. In addition, the course will explore the development of tissue engineering approaches for oral disease treatment, linking these advances to the latest trends in regenerative medicine and immunoengineering.

memo: 碩士級NP實習可免修，請於本所課程委員會申請提案抵免，若提案未通過再選課。 避免系統選課衝突，實習暫定於星期三，但確切實習時間，請與指導教授討論。
crs_outline:
課程摘要：
培養學生運用先備課程之知識建構，同時結合實證護理與醫學，針對臨床之特定領域案例展現批判性思考做出鑑別診斷與照護計畫於急性、急性後之連續性醫療照護體系。實習過程中學生可了解現行進階護理師之執業範疇與限制，並依據自身實習需求，選擇A.4學分臨床實習，B.臨床實習+實務實習活動。
至實習結束每位學生將具備特定領域的進階護理師所需之能力，如領導、實證、政策擬定、教育、臨床進階照護…等。 

教學目標：
A. 4學分臨床實習
1.展現進階護理師之直接照護者角色與功能。
2.展現進階護理師之協調者角色與功能。
3展現進階護理師之健康教育者角色與功能。
4.展現進階護理師於病人照護品質中的角色與功能。
5.運用批判性思考鑑別複雜急性或特定領域病人健康問題之優先次序。
6.運用醫學護理新知識針對複雜或特定領域病人健康問題研擬適當之照護計畫。
7.落差分析進階護理師之執業範疇與特定領域臨床實務之需求。
8.運用分析實證照護與臨床照護之結果於特定領域臨床實務。
9.提升照護品質

B. 臨床實習+實務實習活動，共4學分
1.展現進階護理師之照護者角色與功能。
2.展現進階護理師之健康教育者角色與功能。
3.展現進階護理師於病人照護品質中的角色。
4.分析進階護理師之執業範疇與特定領域臨床實務之需求。
5.運用分析落實實證照護與臨床照護之結果於特定領域臨床實務。
6.提升醫療照護體系的連續照護品質。

memo: 臨護所、在職專班、社區所合班上課。
crs_outline:
The nature and purpose of health and nursing related theories are explored. Paradigmatic progress in health and nursing is also introduced. The methods of concept development are compared and contrasted. The components of theory and the process of theory development are discussed. Several schemes for evaluating theory are presented. The relationships among theory, practice and research are discussed. Students are encouraged to critique, evaluate and utilize appropriate theories within individual practice areas.

Course Objectives
Upon completion of this course, the students will be able to:
1. Identify the components of a model or theory.
2. Ascertain the relationship between knowledge synthesis and concept development.
3. Critically review theories and conceptual models from health and nursing related areas and/or other disciplines for use in advanced practice.
4. Evaluate selected theories and conceptual frameworks using a variety of schemes.
5. Utilize critical thinking skills in the application of theories/conceptual frameworks/models in a variety of clinical environments.
6. Identify the implication of selected theories and conceptual frameworks for various health and nursing related practice or research areas.

crs_outline:
本課程主要是訓練同學在主題式學術報告中，學習邏輯思考，系統性的文獻資料整理，以及獨當一面的報告技巧。本課程期待每位同學於課堂中均必須參與各種不同的角色，包括主講者、主持人、評論員、記錄員、計時員、與提問者等。本課程培養同學如何做好報告、主持學術會議、講評及提問的能力。進階專題討論課則更著重學生英文文獻閱讀、組織、統整與報告的能力。
本課程結束時，學生能
1.	有組織的進行主題報告。
2.	有效的掌握會議進行。
3.	給予適當的學術評論。
4.	適切地提出批判性的問題與回應問題。
5.	撰寫學術論文初步架構的能力。

crs_outline:
課程摘要：
培養學生運用先備課程之知識建構，同時結合實證護理與醫學，針對臨床常見症狀之案例展現批判性思考做出鑑別診斷與照護計畫於急性醫療照護體系中。實習過程了解現行進階護理師之執業範疇與限制。至實習結束每位學生將至少照護十位內外科常見之住院病人，以培養學生具備內外科進階護理師所需之能力。

1.	展現進階護理師之直接照護者角色與功能於急性醫療照護。
2.	展現進階護理師之協調者角色與功能於急性醫療照護。
3.	展現進階護理師之健康教育者角色與功能於急性醫療照護。
4.	展現進階護理師之病人照護品質監控者角色與功能於急性醫療照護。
5.	運用批判性思考鑑別對常見急性病人健康問題之優先次序。
6.	運用醫學護理新知識針對常見急性病人健康問題研擬式當之照護計畫。
7.	瞭解並遵從進階護理師之執業範疇與限制。
8.	分析實證照護與臨床照護之差異。
9.	分析醫護團隊合作於急性醫療照護之重要性。
10.	提升照護品質於急性醫療照護。

cos_cname: 進階內外科護理學實習(一)
teacher: 廖媛美、孫秀卿、黃升苗、陳俞琪、邱愛富、黃淑鶴、陳律言、廖咨詠
memo: 臨護所、在職專班合班上課。
crs_outline:
一、課程概述: 本實習課程使學生能運用臨床護理專家的理論基礎與知識技能，針對其專業領域之病患健康或護理相關議題，進行分析及處置，包括：(一)診斷性評估；(二)問題確立；(三)此問題的研究現況與評析解決方案與所應用之理論架構；(四)實施策略、步驟與評值。期望增加學生對實務的認知，繼而能運用相關的理論及概念，整合與強化處理健康相關議題的直接照護、諮詢、研究、協調以及教育能力。

二、課程目標: 修習完此科目，學生能
1.	瞭解臨床護理專家的角色與功能。
2.	認知目前在成人護理的常見健康議題。
3.	運用批判性思考，整合生理病理、藥理及護理等學科知識，提升評估及發現病患健康問題的能力。
4.	統整評估資料分析及區分病患健康問題優先次序，進而擬定合宜的護理照護計畫。
5.	運用實證護理之概念於解決與處理病患健康相關議題上。
6.	整合及運用研究文獻於臨床實務，並深入分析及批判護理專業問題中，實證研究的現況及困境。
7.	提出解決護理專業問題中，介入性措施與相關研究所面臨的困境及解決方案。
8.	能對病患、家屬及相關人員提供其所需之諮詢與指導。
9.	能與醫療團隊協調合作，運用內外在資源，使病患獲得整體性、持續性的照顧。

teacher: 張秀如、許樹珍、楊秋月、黃莉婷
crs_outline:
課程內容：
	本課程主旨，在於學習個人身體、心理、精神病理、家庭、社會、文化等各層面與精神心理衛生護理之間的相關議題。課程的設計，首先介紹心理健康護理及其相關概念，與精神健康之間的關係；其次再針對個人、醫療文化與社會環境的各種情境，探討對個人精神、行為、生活及文化調適上的影響，以期增進個人適應及發展心理健康護理專業之內涵。

課程目標：
1. 認識精神心理健康相關的概念。
2. 分析社會環境與文化對個人、家庭之心理健康的影響。
3. 認識精神心理衛生護理的發展趨勢與照護策略。

teacher: 黃久美、鄭夙芬、蔡慈儀、陳紀雯、劉佩青
crs_outline:
課程概述：
本課程著重「家庭為中心」之觀點，旨在增進學生批判性分析理論之能力。提供學生一個機會去分析與婦女兒童健康相關之生理、心理社會、及環境因素，強調學生能具備詮釋及操作化特定理論及概念於護理現象/問題之能力，健康概念擴展至與婦女兒童急、慢性健康狀況相關之研究與理論。針對不同家庭週期之家庭，學生能根據上述理論確認、評值或執行相關護理現象/問題、護理活動及成果，提供婦女兒童適切之健康照護，瞭解醫療團隊在家庭照護之角色功能與合作模式，以期協助家庭發展自我照顧能力與健康促進之生活形態。

課程目標：
1. 增進學生系統性思考之能力及了解不同發展週期的家庭之家庭系統與動力，分析與婦女兒童健康相關之生理、心理、社會、及環境影響因素。
2. 增進學生能將家庭相關現象適當地應對至理論/概念的能力，統合與婦女兒童急、慢性健康狀況相關之研究與理論。
3. 增進學生對家庭相關之護理現象/問題提出可測試之假設。
4. 使學生能批判性評值影響家庭健康或福祉之主要護理問題，發展婦女兒童適切之健康照護。
5. 透過瞭解醫療團隊在家庭照護之角色功能與合作模式，協助家庭發展自我照顧能力與健康促進之生活形態。
6. 培養終身學習能力，結合理論與實務，嘗試領導可能的醫護相關成員發展契合婦女兒童之健康需求的健康照護。

crs_outline:
照護個案訂立完整之健康照護計畫，並說明如何運用護理實務面資料於個案本身，特別是在評估護理措施成效方面的應用。此外，學生也能評估發現機構單位面臨之挑戰困境，並整合其他學科的知識、技能與能力，策劃完整性的計畫方案。

Course objectives
1. 學生根據學理及評估個案與他人、環境間關係，建立適宜護理措施 Establish nursing intervention data base including knowledge and understanding relationship between another person and resident environment.
2. 學生透過跨專業合作，提供失能個案完整的健康照護管理 Provide comprehensive health and social care management for disabled persons in collaboration with other health care professionals and agencies.
3.  學生利用社區資源及長照網絡服務，提供轉銜照顧 Provide transitional care by using community resources and establishing long-term care support network for residents.
4.  學生應用護理理論提供個案身心靈方面的護理照護 Apply a theory to the clients via nursing care whose presenting concerns are in the physiological and psycho-social aspects.
5.學生發現機構潛在困難，嘗試提出可行之實證策略 Finding potential problems in the care facilities, and try to apply some workable strategies trough evidence-based researches.

cos_ename: Practice in Advanced Maternity and Pediatric Nursing (II)
crs_outline:
課程概述：
本課程著重「家庭為中心、社區為導向」護理，以臨床實際照護個案及小組討論學習方式，分析影響婦女與兒童及家庭健康相關之生理、心理、社會、及環境因素，針對各發展週期之家庭，配合上課所學概念及理論，強化學生建構家庭系統的概念與培養家庭護理技能，應用於有健康照護需求的婦女及兒童及其家庭。學生能依據家庭理論與概念分析護理現象/問題，應用及臨床實證資料進行現象的分析與假說的形成，並應用家庭護理實務原理與原則，適當地針對婦女、兒童及其家庭之健康需求或問題提供護理照護，並評值結果。

課程目標：
1.	以臨床實習及小組討論方式，內化學理及建構批判性思考及自我引導學習之能力。
2.	強化學生系統性思考之能力及了解各發展週期之家庭系統動態。
3.	運用國內外相關理論與實證研究，增進學生家庭評估、及關懷家庭各層面之的護理現象、與分析確認問題的能力。
4.	增進學生了解家庭護理功能之原則及其脈絡，應用於處理婦女及兒童及其家庭之急、慢性健康問題。
5.	增進學生連結婦女、兒童及其家庭健康相關之生理、心理社會、及環境因素之動態機轉，發展有理論與實證依據之護理計畫，提供個案與家庭之整體及連續的照護。

crs_outline:
本實習課程使學生能運用臨床護理專家的理論基礎和知識技能，針對其專業領域之病患健康或護理相關議題，進行分析及處置。
包括：1.診斷性評估；2.問題確立；3.此問題的研究現況與評析解決方案及所應用之理論架構4.實施策略、步驟、與評值。期望增加學生對實務的認知，繼而能運用相關的理論及概念，整合與強化處理健康相關議題的直接照護、諮詢、研究、協調、以及教育能力。
修習完此科目，學生能
1.	運用批判性思考，整合生理病理、藥理及護理等學科知識，提升評估及發現病患健康問題的能力。
2.	統整評估資料，分析病患健康問題之優先次序，進而擬定合宜的護理照護計畫。
3.	整合及運用研究文獻於臨床實務，並深入分析及批判護理專業問題中，實證研究的現況及困境。
4.	提出解決護理專業問題中，介入性措施與相關研究所面臨的困境及解決方案。
5.	運用實證護理之概念於護理介入措施與照護成果評值。
6.	能與醫療團隊協調合作，運用內外在資源，使病患獲得整體性、持續性的照顧。

crs_outline:
Course Description
The students in this course will use the advanced knowledge and critical thinking skills to identify problems and develop strategies to solve the problem. In addition, this course is designed to develop and evaluate a practical, feasible and evidence-based translation intervention for specific population in various setting. The students will be able to execute action plan, implement the intervention and identify practice measures and outcome measures of the health care project across various settings and across professions. In addition, plan for monitoring objective accomplishment, data analysis and sustainability will be conducted.

Course Objectives
1.	Integrate scientific knowledge and techniques into interprofessional approaches to health care delivery. 
2.	Evaluate the evidence-based care in the current health care environment. 
3.	Identify practice measures and outcome measures of health care intervention.
4.	Understand the structural and economic aspects that affect the quality of health care delivery system. 
5.	Apply leadership, communication and advocacy skills in the development of collaborative, interprofessional patient safety and quality improvement initiatives. 
6.	Evaluate the effects of health care delivery in the design, implementation, and evaluation of care. 
7.	Analyze science of health care delivery, quality and safety into a healthcare delivery improvement project.
8.	Develop plan of suitability for long term goal.

crs_outline:
課程概述
本課程的目的是結合人文應用與實證及轉譯概念與理論，提高進階護理師改善個案、家庭與群體健康的影響和重要性的實踐，以提供最佳的健康方案。此外，學生能夠運用評估技巧發現個案家庭、社區之健康議題 ，以批判性和系統性思考進行比較落差分析，運用實證及轉譯概念與理論，發展並領導改善方案。 

課程目標
1.	剖析個人至群體的健康需求。
2.	確定健康的社會決定因素，並描述社會決定因素對健康的影響
3.	運用批判性和系統性思考進行比較落差分析評估、比較、描述和監測個人至群體健康。
4.	運用實證及轉譯概念與理論發展最適當之最佳的健康方案。
5.	運用適宜之群體與場域(含社區)評估發展實證為基礎之健康促進與疾病預防介入措施於臨床情境或社區中。
6.	根據實證和轉譯技能制定策略，減少最佳照顧方式與臨床實務之間的差距提升照護品質。

crs_outline:
課程大綱： 
過去RNA一直被當成細胞裡的灰姑娘，執行細胞裡的基本工作，如今卻成為未來醫學深具治療潛力的新星。幾十年來的RNA研究新見解，讓科學家在面對許多棘手疾病時，以RNA做為治療工具，開創RNA醫療的新境界。本課程將著重討論RNA藥物的特有技術和優勢，同時也讓大家了解microRNA 或 Circular RNA的疾病原因，對人類藥物治療策略所產生的影響。

crs_outline: 細胞生物學是了解原核及真核生物的構造、生長、行為等等重要的學科。而高等細胞生物學則針對細胞的生理，以分子生物的角度來詳細介紹為何單純的細胞會有這麼多複雜的行為。課程將從細胞的膜、胞器、分子傳遞、訊息傳導、細胞週期與死亡、細胞微結構與外界環境之交互作用、幹細胞、以及癌症發生等等來逐一介紹。除了指定之教科書外、也會介紹最新的研究論文，以及未來的趨勢。修課同學也必須選讀一篇一年內發表在細胞生物領域相關期刊之論文，並做口頭報告。This course is focused on the molecular events of cells to elucidate the complicate physiological phenomena, including structures, proliferation and behaviors. It will cover but not limit to the cell membrane, organelles, intracellular molecular transport, singal transduction, cell cycle and death, cytoskeletons, microenvironmental interaction, stem cell biology, and etiology of cancer cells. In addition to the indicated textbook, the most update papers in cell biology field will be discussed to understand the future tendency of research. Moreover, students are assigned to oral present two contemporary reports related the cell biological research.

dep_cname: 生物醫學影像暨放射科學系

crs_outline:
課程概述與目標：
課程上課時間：11/23~11/28 上午9：00~中午12：00
課程上課方式：實體+線上授課
課程概述與目標：
This course covers a wide spectrum of hybrid nuclear cardiac imaging and quantification. The course will start with an introduction of medical physics and instrumentation of various medical imaging systems, followed by a comprehensive description of image generation, reconstruction and correction for advanced hybrid radionuclide imaging. Methodology and validation of nuclear cardiac image quantification for the detection of abnormalities of myocardial perfusion and left ventricular function will be extensively described and experimental data and clinical cases will be illustrated accordingly. In addition, special lectures for advanced molecularly targeted and sympathetic cardiac imaging and quantification will be presented. Ultimately, students will be provided with a unique Yale software package (Wackers-Liu CQ?) for nuclear cardiac SPECT and PET quantifications. This software package can be installed in students’ computers and used for teaching and research purposes. The course will be concluded with a step-by-step demonstration by the instructor as well as with hand-on practices by the students to use the Wackers-Liu CQ? software and to learn clinical diagnoses based on the images and quantitative results of several preloaded clinical cases.

crs_outline:
課程說明：本課程為提供學生與復健臨床實務相關的神經生理學知識。內容涵蓋從神經元與膠細胞的基本細胞生理機制、突觸傳導原理、神經傳導系統、感覺與動作系統的運作機制(包含基底核、小腦與前庭系統在動作規劃、執行與平衡控制中的關鍵功能)，到神經可塑性與影像技術在臨床應用上的介紹。課程亦結合專家講授，介紹如功能性近紅外線光譜儀（fNIRS）、功能性磁振造影（fMRI）及電生理檢查在神經復健中的應用，增進學生對神經生理與臨床間的整合理解。
課程目標：	1. 了解神經生理的基本原理及其在中的角色。
2.了解神經傳導系統的運作方式與生理機制。
3. 建立動作系統與感覺系統對動作控制的神經機轉。
4. 分析神經生理知識如何應用於臨床復健實務。
5. 認識神經影像與電生理技術在神經復健中的應用潛力。
